parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Replace $\tan\theta$ with $\sin\theta/\cos\theta$. M1. Replace $\sin^2\theta$ with $1-\cos^2\theta$ to obtain a 3-term quadratic in $\cos\theta$; accept a cubic with common factor $\cos\theta$; condone sign errors during simplification. *M1. Obtain $9\cos^2\theta+\cos\theta-4=0$. A1 OE. Attempt to solve their 3-term quadratic by a valid method; correct values are $0.6134$ and $-0.7245$. DM1. Any two of $\pm52.2^\circ$, $\pm136.4^\circ$. A1 AWRT as final answers. All four values. A1; condone answers outside range but no others within it. After M1 *M1 A1 DM0, correct answers can score SC B1B1. Total: 6.
